headline: Judge compares Durk to Elon Musk: $1B bounty joke
body: Trap Lore Ross reports a judge likened rapper Durk to Elon Musk, joking that if Musk offered a $1 billion bounty for an opponent, no one would take it seriously. The comment came amid Durk's legal trial updates, with the judge noting the rapper's recent jury challenges. Ross's post shows high engagement with 6,615 likes and 490 comments.
